movies.title: Musk
movies.overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.
movies.tagline: An unflinching look at Earth's most unchecked man.

movies.title: Fjord
movies.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

movies.title: Jailer 2
movies.overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with the consequences of his actions against the antique mafia.

movies.title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
movies.overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

movies.title: Street Fighter
movies.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

movies.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
movies.overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.
movies.tagline: Sometimes the truth needs a second opinion.

movies.title: Whalefall
movies.overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

movies.title: Crawlers
movies.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

movies.title: Ranabaali
movies.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.
movies.tagline: The legend of the cursed land.

movies.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
movies.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
